The table above shows some values of the linear function $f$. Which of the following functions defines $f$?
explanation: Choice B is correct. Since $f$ is a linear function, it can be written in the form $f(x) = mx + b$, where $m$ and $b$ are constants. The values of $m$ and $b$ can be found using the given values of $f$. When $x = 0$, $f(x) = 7$, so $7 = m(0) + b$, or $b = 7$. When $x = -4$, $f(x) = -5$, so $-5 = m(-4) + 7$, or $-5 = -4m + 7$. Subtracting 7 from both sides of this equation gives $-12 = -4m$, which divides to $m = 3$. Therefore, $f(x) = 3x + 7$.
